wo-jpfa-JR3596.d:
Job Summary**

Responsible for ensuring the quality of products within the WRH (Warehouse) area of the RPU Megaluh facility, performing quality control checks and maintaining compliance with established standards.

Job Responsibilities**

* Conduct visual inspections and quality checks on incoming, in-process, and outgoing products within the warehouse.
* Verify product specifications, labeling, and packaging adhere to company standards and regulatory requirements.
* Record and document quality control data accurately and completely.
* Identify and report any non-conforming products or quality issues to the immediate supervisor.
* Assist in the investigation of quality deviations and implement corrective actions as required.
* Maintain a clean and organized work environment in the QC area.
* Participate in internal and external audits as needed.
* Follow all safety procedures and company policies.

Job Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in quality control or a manufacturing environment, preferably in the agricultural or food processing sector.
* Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Basic computer skills (e.g., data entry).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Good communication skills.
* Physically able to stand for extended periods and lift moderate weights.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
